newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CHEMOPETROL SIGNS 7YR SYND LOAN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CHEMOPETROL SIGNS 7YR SYND LOAN.

text.p: Czech petrochemical concern Chemopetrol a.s. on Tuesday signed a seven-year, 230 million mark syndicated loan, lead managed by Citibank International plc.
Officials speaking at a signing ceremony for the loan did not disclose any details of the interest rate for the credit.
Officials said funds from the loan would be used for reconstruction of the firm's electrical power generating station.
They added that the loan was originally to be for 215 million marks, but interest on behalf of the banks was very high, and the amount extended to 230 million marks.
Banks co-arranging the loan include Ceska Sporitelna, Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka, ABN Amro, Bank Austria, Societe Generale, and Union Bank of Switzerland.
